thread.title: Video: What to Expect From Microsoft's Earnings Thursday

author: Home
title: Video: What to Expect From Microsoft's Earnings Thursday
text:
Microsoft ( MSFT ) is set to report quarterly earnings on Thursday after the closing bell.
All eyes are on its Azure cloud product, which has been a cornerstone of the company's move to expand beyond software.
Microsoft is a serious contender in the race to the world's first trillion dollar company with a market cap of over $800 billion. Tech rivals like Apple ( AAPL ) and Amazon ( AMZN ) are also close to the milestone.
Microsoft, Apple and Amazon are holdings of Action Alerts PLUS.
